review_notes: I read the whole file. It contains only lemmas, no new definitions, structures or classes. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. The lemmas build on existing Mathlib concepts: HasSum, Summable, tsum, HasProd, HasAntidiagonal, SemiconjBy and Commute. I grepped Mathlib for same-named HasSum/Summable mul_left, mul_right and div_const lemmas, and for tsum_mul_left and tsum_div_const. The only other matches are `tsum_mul_left` in Topology/Instances/NNReal/Lemmas.lean and Topology/Algebra/InfiniteSum/ENNReal.lean. Those are specialisations to ℝ≥0 and ℝ≥0∞, which are different type classes. They are not independent competing versions of a concept, and I did not read them in detail. I found no justified finding.
